typicalBarText: Junior developer bar requires proven ability to contribute clean, tested code to production repositories, actively participate in code reviews, debug incidents with supervision, and operate basic CI/CD automation.
checklistItems: Production code contributions and shipped release pull requests
Automated unit testing suites (Jest, PyTest, JUnit) and CI/CD awareness
Defect debugging, issue triage, and collaborative code reviews
expectedSignals: Code review participation and debugging skills

scoredSignals.label: Production Codebase Contributions
scoredSignals.description: Shipped features, merged pull requests, and production deployment lifecycle contributions.

scoredSignals.label: Code Review & Root Cause Debugging
scoredSignals.description: Active participation in peer reviews, debugging defects, and resolving technical debt.

scoredSignals.label: Automated Testing & CI/CD Pipelines
scoredSignals.description: Unit testing suites and continuous integration pipeline automation.

scoredSignals.label: Agile Delivery & Team Collaboration
scoredSignals.description: Cross-functional sprint cadence, backlog prioritization, and iterative shipping.

adviceCards.title: Highlight Automated Test Coverage & CI/CD
adviceCards.recommendation: Highlight automated test coverage percentages and automated deployment pipeline experience in your bullets.

adviceCards.title: Cite Production Releases & Pull Requests
adviceCards.recommendation: Quantify features merged into production and release cycles to prove independent code contribution.
